description: Unified SSE Sector Taxonomy Crosswalk v2.5 (FAIR & SKOS). 17 industry sectors + 3 non-sector facets (role, population/cause, employer type). Imported from SSE sector taxonomy crosswalk MASTER.xlsx.

decision_rules.issue: Conflated between Education and Care Services.
decision_rules.rule: Primary skos:broadMatch to Education; Secondary skos:relatedMatch to Care Services. Expression: skos:broadMatch Education AND (skos:relatedMatch CareServices)

decision_rules.issue: Crosses employment training, manufacturing, and social care.
decision_rules.rule: Mapped to Employment & Workforce Integration as primary sector, with sub-activity tags. Expression: skos:exactMatch WorkIntegration AND (skos:broadMatch SocialEnterprise)

decision_rules.issue: Ambiguous in French sources (tourist lodging vs. emergency housing).
decision_rules.rule: Tourist lodging -> Recreation, Tourism & Hospitality; Emergency shelters/HLMs -> Housing & Collective Real Estate.
decision_rules.reference: ISIC Rev. 4 Section I vs Section Q

decision_rules.issue: Crosses academic education, policy advocacy, and B2B consulting.
decision_rules.rule: Institutional social research -> Education & Knowledge; Private market research -> Business & Professional Services.

decision_rules.issue: Scraped job boards list occupational duties alongside sectors.
decision_rules.rule: Decoupled into standalone Role Facet (Row 18) and mapped to NOC 2021 / ISCO-08.

decision_rules.issue: Target demographic tags (Youth, Women) conflated with industry.
decision_rules.rule: Decoupled into standalone Population/Cause Facet (Row 19) and mapped to UN SDGs.

decision_rules.issue: Legal organization forms (Co-op, NPO, Social Enterprise) confused with sector.
decision_rules.rule: Decoupled into standalone Legal Form Facet (Row 20) and mapped to legal registries.

sectors.label_fr: Services sociaux, de santé et de soins
sectors.definition_en: Provision of physical and mental health care, early childhood and elder care, home support, mutual aid, poverty relief, and newcomer settlement services operated under democratic, non-capitalist, or community-governed models.
sectors.scope_note_en: Inclusions: Health clinics, home care (EÉSAD), mental health, disability support, eldercare, addiction recovery, newcomer/refugee settlement, drop-in centers. Exclusions: Purely commercial healthcare facilities; early childhood education is mapped here as a secondary facet when integrated with care.
exclusions: early childhood education is mapped here as a secondary facet when integrated with care
sectors.example_en: Example: Health clinics; home care (EÉSAD); mental health.
sectors.boundary_note_en: Exclusions: Purely commercial healthcare facilities; early childhood education is mapped here as a secondary facet when integrated with care.

skos.compound_mapping_rule: skos:exactMatch CareServices AND (skos:relatedMatch Education OR skos:relatedMatch Health)
